name: toast
title: Toast
description: Actionable feedback on Base UI Toast that docks into a host cell or floats at the inline-end corner: done, failed, info, warning and loading kinds, a description line, one action (Undo, Retry), the countdown draining the keyline. useToaster() and createToaster() add promise tracking, update and dismiss, and calls from outside React.

.kl-toast-floating .kl-toast.transition: transform var(--kl-ts-move) var(--kl-ts-ease), inset-inline var(--kl-ts-move) var(--kl-ts-ease), height var(--kl-ts-move) var(--kl-ts-ease), background-color var(--kl-t-unfold) linear, border-color var(--kl-t-unfold) linear, opacity var(--kl-ts-move) linear

.kl-toast-dock .kl-toast.transition: clip-path var(--kl-t-unfold) var(--kl-ease-out), transform var(--kl-ts-move) var(--kl-ts-ease), opacity var(--kl-t-unfold) linear
